mac_reality_limitations: Current Mac reality is measured evidence, not proof of historical production identity.
Historical byte identity and continued production use remain unprovable from the transferred package.
Session metadata establishes recorded Claude/Codex working directories; it does not convert every historical path into a production path.
Secret-bearing field names are recorded only as booleans; secret values are not imported into the binding.
